entities.summary: Vitaliy Valeriyovych Kropachov is a Ukrainian businessman and owner of the Ukrdoninvest Group of companies, has assets in the machine-building, construction, and transport industries, as well as media assets, including ERA Production and the Ukraine World News television channel.
